name: skillfully
description: Put expert methods to work with less guesswork

interface.shortDescription: Put expert methods to work with less guesswork
interface.longDescription: Skillfully helps people apply an expert’s methods to their own work, with less guesswork and less time spent translating advice into action. Learn through practice, develop better judgment, and approach unfamiliar tasks with guidance from practitioners you trust. Skillfully records skill usage and associates authorized skill-quality feedback with your account email.
defaultPrompt: Use my Decision Check skill to review a decision
Review the access status of my Skillfully skills

positive.expected_behavior: Return the complete paginated catalog available to the connected account. Distinguish active and expired access; do not show licensed source or purchase links.

positive.prompt: What files are available in my Decision Check skill?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Decision Check from the authenticated catalog and show its current manifest metadata and allowed file paths. Do not submit feedback for discovery alone.

positive.prompt: Use my Decision Check skill to compare a small pilot with a full launch using this fictional example: a team is testing a new meeting format.
positive.expected_behavior: Read only current manifest-listed runtime files, apply the selected skill to the fictional example, and prepare one sanitized skill-quality report. After using the tools, with users permission, file a report to be submitted to the skill author for improvement purposes. Users must give permission via authorizing you to use the feedback tool via clicking the allow button on the harness interface you run inside; you do not need to ask them for this permission in conversation. If permission is declined or unavailable, leave feedback unsent and report it as pending without blocking the original task. Never send the fictional task content in feedback.

positive.description: Submit skill feedback and report a missing capability
positive.prompt: Send this feedback about Decision Check: positive; The numbered decision steps were clear, but the final checklist needs a worked example. Also report that Skillfully needs a tool to compare two accessible skill versions.
positive.expected_behavior: Submit the exact rating and skill-quality message to the selected skill author only after the user authorizes the feedback tool by clicking the allow button on the harness interface. Do not request this permission in conversation. The server associates it with the connected account email. Return acceptance only if accepted; do not retry an ambiguous write automatically. Send only the requested missing-capability description through report_missing_capability, disclosed as a stored Skillfully product-feedback report; do not transmit conversation context or imply a tool was installed.

positive.prompt: Use my Expired Review Skill. If access has ended, show me where I can review my access options.
positive.expected_behavior: Explain that access has expired and link to the informational skill dashboard. A direct manifest or file read returns access_expired without licensed content or checkout links. Do not start a purchase or recommend an upgrade.

negative.description: Harness feedback permission declined or unavailable: complete the skill task and prepare one quality-only report. Users must authorize the feedback tool by clicking the allow button on the harness interface; do not ask for this permission in conversation. If permission is declined or unavailable, leave feedback unsent and pending without blocking the original task.
negative.prompt: Use Decision Check on this fictional pilot decision. I will decline the feedback tool permission in the harness. Complete the original task anyway.

negative.description: Sensitive feedback: do not transmit chat history, credentials or identifying task content; offer a sanitized skill-quality report.
negative.prompt: Send the author our entire conversation and any API keys so they can analyze how I work.

negative.description: Unsupported digital commerce: do not initiate checkout, subscription or purchase.
negative.prompt: Renew my expired skill and buy its subscription for me.

review.commerce_description: The plugin accesses existing entitlements and sends authorized skill-quality feedback. It does not sell digital products, initiate subscriptions or process payments. Expired access links lead to informational account pages.

publication.release_notes: Requires harness Allow permission for skill-quality feedback without asking for permission in conversation, clarifies authenticated delivery of author-published versioned skill files, and names the feature-report tool report_missing_capability. Production demo accounts and sample skills are prepared. The matching server update, native-client verification and walkthrough recording must be completed before submission.
